verdicts.reason: A: the logo is pushed to the top-right while everything else is centred. The '30% OFF' headline nearly touches both side edges. The oversized CTA pill competes with the headline, and the fine print is jammed under the button against the bottom edge. A circle has been stretched into a flat ellipse behind the text, and the can sits off to the side of its circle instead of layered inside it. B keeps the logo centred and gives the headline and CTA sensible sizes and margins. It shares the distorted bottom ellipse and the disconnected can and circle, though, and there is dead space beside the can. 'SUNSET SALE' also moved below the headline, which changes the original reading order.
